description: This PHP class 'HolidayController' is part of the OrangeHRM system, specifically within the Leave plugin's Controller namespace. It extends an abstract Vue.js controller to manage the holiday listing view, utilizing traits and external components to prepare data for rendering.

classes.name: HolidayController
classes.description: A controller class for managing and rendering the holiday list component within the Leave plugin, extending a base Vue controller and using trait for leave period services.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the holiday list component with the current leave period data, for rendering in a Vue.js view.
